abstract.p: We report our participation in the SemEval-2025 shared task on classification of emotions and describe our solutions using BERT-based models and their modifications. We participate in tracks A and B. We apply and compare base XLM-RoBERTa, Adversarial Domain Adaptation (ADA) on the XLM-RoBERTa with the length of the text as the adversarial feature. As a simple baseline, we also use a Logistic Regression based on tf-idf features. We show that using ADA increases the f1 macro score in low-resource languages and in shorter texts. Besides, we describe our approach to track A where we use ADA with the text language as the confounder. We show that for some languages it helps to improve the f1 score.
